reason: I'll make the break first so the platelet plug has a place to form. The intro explains how the rough edge damages skin and a vessel.
expectation: I expect a small cut in the skin and blood vessel, though I don't know exactly how it will be shown.

alternatives.reason: The enzymes are labelled as helping make reinforcing threads, but I want to make the break first.

effect: The cut is in place, and the narrowed vessel is still leaking, so it needs a plug.
reaction: The narrowing was a small surprise, but the leak makes the next step clear.
reason: The picture shows platelets gathering at a torn vessel, so I'll use them to make the plug.
expectation: I expect platelets to gather at the damaged vessel and reduce the leak, though it may still need reinforcing threads.

alternatives.reason: The clotting enzymes can help make reinforcing threads, but I'll form the plug first.

effect: The platelet plug slowed the leak, so reinforcing it is the remaining goal.
reaction: It makes sense that the platelets pile up at the break rather than fixing the whole cut immediately.
reason: The only offered combination matches the goal: the enzyme label says it helps clotting proteins form threads.
expectation: I expect reinforcing threads to form from the dissolved protein, though they may need a separate step to join the plug.

effect: The proteins formed a mesh, and the new goal is to stop the bleeding by combining it with the plug.
reaction: The branching mesh makes reinforcement easy to picture.
reason: The only offered combination brings the threads to the platelet plug to stop the leak.
expectation: I expect the mesh to reinforce the plug and stop the bleeding.

effect: The mesh reinforced the plug and stopped the bleeding, completing the chapter, but the skin still needs to heal.
reaction: The open skin was a useful reminder that stopping bleeding isn't the same as healing the cut.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the two parts work together to stop the leak.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the protein threads was less engaging on its own: the enzyme label already said what would happen, and it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The vessel narrowed after the cut but still leaked; I hadn't expected the narrowing.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The labels and pictures explained the pairings, though the final choices were the only offered combinations.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the open skin heals; stopping the bleeding feels like only the first part of the story.
